name: todo-api
description: Go REST API owning todos and lists, backed by an embedded SQLite database. Every operation is scoped to the authenticated caller (X-User-Id). Does not validate JWTs itself and does not implement any /auth/* endpoints — sign-in is delegated to Thunder via the shared user-auth dependency.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Shared Thunder auth resource; the gateway validates callers' JWTs and injects X-User-Id before requests reach this service.

componentAgentInstructions: No /auth/* endpoints. The API Platform gateway validates the JWT and the api-configuration trait's jwt-auth policy injects identity headers on every request: X-User-Id (the caller's opaque IdP subject) and X-User-Groups (the caller's role groups, a JSON array — unused here, this system has a single role). Stamp X-User-Id as the owner of this service's own rows (reject 401 when missing). Do NOT validate JWTs yourself; do NOT add CORS middleware (the gateway handles CORS). Use modernc.org/sqlite (pure-Go); driver name is "sqlite". Store the DB under /data/todo-api.db.
